steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: So, you must be Misha?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I've heard a lot about you from Skullshatterer. Now, I finally get to meet you.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Are you also... Infected...?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Why did you... join Reunion?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: My wife, my child... they were all killed by the Chernobogians.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Under Ursus, the Infected were treated worse than lifestock.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The destruction of Chernobog...? No, no. That is far too light of a punishment...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Do you know how much blood is on their hands?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Misha... We've been feared, exploited, humiliated, and persecuted...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Just because of the fact that we're Infected.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Not for any other reason.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: S-sorry, I got a bit heated. Forget what I said.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Ivan, come help tend to the injured.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Coming.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We're only using this abandoned mine as a temporary base until we can reorganize and regroup.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Once the time is right, we'll make our way back to Chernobog.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I threw away that name long ago.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: That person already died.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Just call me Skullshatterer.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Are you... afraid?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Skull...shatterer? ...Why?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Ah... You'll soon understand.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: After we learned that you ended up as a refugee in Lungmen, everyone volunteered to go rescue you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We've also accepted many new members there.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But... you're hurting people.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't want to... do that...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Why are the Infected fighting each other...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: An eye for an eye, as things should be.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: There is a saying in Ursus. 'Welcome your kin as you would welcome the warm spring...'

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: 'But welcome your enemies...'

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...Do you know?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: No... No, you don't.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: When they came for me, they dragged me out of my house...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I saw my mother. She grabbed my hand...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You saw it too.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You must have--

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: They beat her mercilessly, but she wouldn't let go of me...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: She left a trail of blood in the snow as they dragged her away.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: If Reunion had... If the Infected could have... If only--!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: If they came sooner, none of this would have happened!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We would not have had to suffer so much!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I... I wasn't brave enough to...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I... Aaaahh...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Misha...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: It'll be fine... It'll all be fine in the end.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I don't blame you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Back then... who would've been brave enough?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But now, Reunion has given me that bravery.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Al--

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Skullshatterer...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Whether or not you trust us is up to you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Even if you trust us, whether or not you join us is also up to you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But you are an Infected.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Reunion... will definitely fight until the bitter end so that the Infected can be free.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But... you destroyed Chernobog.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Along with countless innocents--

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...Innocents?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Hah. Who's innocent?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: When Chernobog implemented the quarantine, did any of them speak out against it?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: When Ursus sent us to die in the mines and the frozen wastelands, did any of them do anything about it?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Did any of them ever stand up for us?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...Reunion has two leaders who fought for Ursus for a long time.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: They said that there were some in Ursus who stood against the government for the sake of the Infected.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But they weren't in Chernobog.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Chernobog coldly turned a blind eye towards us as we died...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: No, they laughed as they watched us die!!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Chernobog... deserved to be destroyed!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I met other people who were helping the Infected... They...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Despite being Infected, they helped Lungmen and harmed us, didn't they?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: They slew our comrades and decimated our brethren, didn't they?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You couldn't see the truth. But it should be clear to you now...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...Sorry, I let my anger take over.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: It's fine... I...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I understand how you feel...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You must have been suffering so much... all this time...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Everyone has been through a lot.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But right now, at least we have hope.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Talulah... She is the one who took charge of the Infected and led the fight against the cruelty of this world.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Reunion is the only hope we have.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I see... You've all suffered so much...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If Reunion can really protect them all...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Just like how Reunion will protect everyone... I will protect you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I won't let anyone hurt you anymore.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Skullshatterer...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ooh, I found 'em--!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Looks like they sustained some pretty serious losses.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Luckily, I didn't head back to the company headquarters... Otherwise, I would've needed to make a long detour for this mission...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Try to predict their escape routes.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Send all likely routes along with their bearings to Amiya.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll be done in a sec!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We can't give Reunion time to regroup.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmmm, let's see... over here... like this... and that should do it!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you done, Exusiai?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What do you need? How are we going to do this?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's have a little warm-up first.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Start with their sentries.
